answer: Each identity claims one vertex, burns onyx for three edges to three vertex holders, and passes a whisper quorum confirming each request, so one key cannot mint many silently. Edges cost 40, 50, 60 credits, 150 per identity, vertex-bound, unusable twice. A vertex with an identity charges 10 more per edge next, so the kth shared-vertex identity pays 150+30(k-1), the 1000th 30120, and 1000 fakes over 15 million, while an honest agent pays 150 once. A rented-edge ring fails: the whisper quorum checks prior transactions, and a neighbor endorsing a fake loses its edge bond.
